name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; descriptor accurately states the behavior (add an item to inventory). No Ghidra address residue. Body matches: scan 8 slots, fill first empty one. Keep.
purpose: Add item_id to the first empty inventory slot of runtime_char[char_idx]; returns 1 on success, -1 if all 8 slots are full.
logic_summary: rc = data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr. Loop slot_iter 0..7 over the 8 two-byte inventory slots of rc[char_idx]. A slot is empty when its flag byte (inventory_slots[slot*2]) has bit 0x80 set. On the first empty slot: set flag byte = 0 (occupied, not equipped), store inventory_slots[slot*2+1] = (uint8)item_id, return 1. If no empty slot found, return -1. Slot flag bits: 0x80 = empty, 0x40 = equipped (mutually exclusive with 0x80), 0 = occupied but not equipped. Only the low byte of item_id is stored.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr selecting which character's inventory receives the item.
params.reason: Accurately names the character-array index; no address residue.

params.name: item_id
params.semantics: Item id to store into the slot; only the low byte is written (item ids span 0x00..0xD6).
params.reason: Domain-meaningful item-id parameter; name matches usage. Keep.

returns.semantics: 1 = item added to a free slot; -1 = all 8 inventory slots are full (item not added).
